render_note: The plan is a 1-bit JBIG2 bitmap of 626 x 448 pixels placed at one source pixel per PDF point; at 72 dpi one render pixel equals one source pixel, which avoids fits locking onto single stair steps of the enlarged bitmap (picks v1 on the 300 dpi render).

north.evidence: Fig. 22.2 (PDF p. 590, printed p. 1288), upper middle of the plan: a needle-shaped arrow with one filled half, a circled 'N' at its middle and a split tail; no word 'true' or 'magnetic' appears on the plan or in its caption 'Location of Harappan Cemetery (KLB-8)'. The needle form may follow a magnetic-needle drafting convention, but nothing on the plan states it, so the class is left unspecified.
north.survey_year_evidence: Plan title 'KALIBANGAN : 1960-69'; the survey maps were prepared during the 1960-69 excavation seasons (Acknowledgements, PDF p. 7). The first year of the range is recorded.

scale.evidence: Vertical scale bar at right of the plan; end ticks labelled 100 and 100 with 0 at y=530 and a half tick at y=565; metres. Labels are barely legible in the bitmap; the reading gives KLB-2 dimensions of about 360 by 240 m.
